scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @chat-analyze/server && npm run build -w @chat-analyze/ui
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run typecheck:ui" "npm run typecheck:server"
scripts.preflight: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
